The '''Nilg system''' was located in the [[Alderath sector/Legends|Alderath sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> By approximately [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{JournalCite|1|Wanted by Cracken (Star Wars Adventure Journal)}} establishes that the "[[Wanted by Cracken (Star Wars Adventure Journal)|Wanted by Cracken]]" segment of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' represents an [[in-universe]] update to the [[Datafile/Legends|datafile]] ''[[Wanted by Cracken]]'', the original version of which is presented in the sourcebook [[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']]. The latter work is dated to three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], and since ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates that conflict to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the placement of the sourcebook therefore translates to [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]]. Furthermore, {{JournalCite|10|Wanted by Cracken (Star Wars Adventure Journal)}} establishes that [[Tolad Dor]] was active in the Nilg [[Star system/Legends|system]] at least two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the segment's setting.</ref> the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Gangster/Legends|gangster]] [[Tolad Dor]] was active in the Nilg [[Star system/Legends|system]], a fact that was eventually noted by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] in an entry of the [[Datafile/Legends|datafile]] ''[[Wanted by Cracken]]''<ref name="Journal10">{{JournalCite|10|Wanted by Cracken (Star Wars Adventure Journal)}}</ref>&mdash;the initial version of which was published in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]]<ref name="Date" />&mdash;dedicated to the [[Saboteur/Legends|saboteur]] [[Ostan Atur]].<ref name="Journal10" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Nilg system was first mentioned in the "[[Wanted by Cracken (Star Wars Adventure Journal)|Wanted by Cracken]]" segment of the [[May]] [[1996]] [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 10|tenth issue]] of [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]''. The segment was authored by [[Craig Robert Carey|C. Robert Carey]].<ref name="Journal10" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the system in grid square L-7.<ref name="TEA" />
